title: Войновка — Кокшаровский, 2ЭС6
coordinate_note: Graphical digitization; PDF cells used at their centres. No station pickets or exact segment coordinates are stated. Intervals derived from vector geometry (1 cm per km). Use as training map, not surveyed track passport. Current changes have text anchors on continuous strokes; those boundaries are approximate.
warnings: The source is a 2018 regime card; no claim that speeds are valid today.
The source contains weight rows 8000, 6300 and 2500 t; no 6000 t row. Display 6300 t recommendations as comparison for the 6000 t simulation, without interpolation.
Station name on cover differs: Кошкаровский; graph labels the terminal station Кокшаровский.
Signal drawings show a scheme with multiple coloured circles, not a current ALSN indication. Do not automatically power safety code from their colours.
An unmarked gap in the recommendation stroke does not specify a traction current.
Empty-wagon dashed speed limits do not apply to the loaded 6000 t consist.
The PDF draws one curve on page 9 without a radius label (roughly 1966.106–1965.107 km). Its curvature resistance cannot be verified from this source; no radius is invented.
